name: Tutorial UI
description: Tutorial overlay DOM and interactions. Documents the dark transparent backdrop, positioned tooltip-style step card, target element border-ring highlighting, step indicator dots, navigation buttons with Back/Skip/Next/Done variants, arrow key navigation, external link rendering in Stay Connected step, 'Do not show this again' checkbox on final step, and visual states including hidden, active, and final-step.

dom.root: .tutorial-overlay (fullscreen fixed dark transparent backdrop, display:none/display:flex toggled)

elements.overlay: .tutorial-overlay — fixed inset:0, z-index above canvas, dark semi-transparent background
elements.tooltip: .tutorial-tooltip — positioned step card (min-width:360px, max-width:520px) containing step header, body, optional extra content, and navigation
elements.ring: .tutorial-ring — absolutely positioned border-highlight div drawn over highlighted target element, display:none/display:block toggled
elements.step_body: .tutorial-step-body — step description text element (newlines preserved via pre-wrap or equivalent)
elements.extra: div — optional container appended only when renderExtra callback produces children (links in Stay Connected, checkbox in Thank You)
elements.nav: .tutorial-nav > .tutorial-dots (step indicator dots, one per step, .active class on current step index) + .tutorial-btn-row
elements.back_btn: button.tutorial-btn.tutorial-btn-back — '← Back' text, hidden (not rendered) on first step (stepIdx===0), click calls prev()
elements.next_btn: button.tutorial-btn.tutorial-btn-next — 'Next →' text, rendered on all steps except last, click calls next()
elements.done_btn: button.tutorial-btn.tutorial-btn-done — 'Done' text, rendered only on last step, click reads checkbox state then calls close()
elements.dot: span.tutorial-dot — step indicator dot, .active class on current step, always present for all steps
elements.spacer: div (flex:1) — spacer in btn-row when Back button is absent (first step)
elements.links: div.tutorial-links > a.tutorial-link — external URL links (Report issue, Check updates, View GitHub) in Stay Connected step, click fires shell:openExternal IPC
elements.checkbox_label: label.tutorial-cb-label > input[type=checkbox] — 'Do not show this again' checkbox on final step, default checked=true

interactions.name: next_step
interactions.trigger: click on .tutorial-btn-next button OR ArrowRight keydown OR Enter keydown
interactions.action: If stepIdx < STEPS.length - 1: fire prevOnLeave callback (step.onLeave) if set → clear prevOnLeave → clearHighlight (ring display:none) → increment stepIdx → showStep() renders new step header/body/dots/buttons → fire step.onEnter if defined → position tooltip near target or center
interactions.result: Advances to next tutorial step; target element highlighted if step has target selector; tooltip repositioned

interactions.name: previous_step
interactions.trigger: click on .tutorial-btn-back button OR ArrowLeft keydown
interactions.action: If stepIdx > 0: fire prevOnLeave if set → clear prevOnLeave → clearHighlight → decrement stepIdx → showStep() renders new step → fire step.onEnter if defined → reposition tooltip

interactions.name: close_overlay
interactions.action: Fire prevOnLeave if set → clearHighlight → set overlay display:none, tooltip display:none → fire stored onCloseCb → null onCloseCb
interactions.result: Tutorial overlay hidden; onClose callback invoked (App uses this to persist showTutorial pref via IPC prefs:save)

interactions.name: complete_tutorial
interactions.trigger: click on .tutorial-btn-done button on final step
interactions.action: Read checkbox state from extra container (checked !== true means showOnLaunch=false) → update internal showOnLaunch flag → then same close sequence as close_overlay (prevOnLeave, clearHighlight, hide, fire onCloseCb)
interactions.result: Tutorial completed; showOnLaunch preference set based on checkbox state; onClose callback invoked

interactions.name: highlight_target
interactions.trigger: showStep() when step.target selector is defined
interactions.action: querySelector(step.target) → getBoundingClientRect() → set .tutorial-ring left/top/width/height to target rect values → display:block. If step.overflowHidden: set target element style.overflow='hidden'. Then positionTooltip(step.target): calculate available space in 4 quadrants — prefer below target (rect.bottom+12, clamped left), else above, else right of, else left of, else center-screen fallback. Tooltip width clamped to Math.min(360, vw-40); CSS min-width:360px / max-width:520px.
interactions.result: Ring highlight border drawn over target element; tooltip positioned near target within viewport bounds

interactions.name: open_external_link
interactions.trigger: click on a.tutorial-link inside renderExtra on Stay Connected step
interactions.action: e.preventDefault() → window.electronAPI.shell.openExternal(url) opens URL in default browser
interactions.result: External link (GitHub issue/release/repo) opens in browser

states.hidden: Overlay display:none, tooltip display:none, ring display:none. Document keydown listener is registered but checks overlay display and returns early (no-op). stepIdx and showOnLaunch flags preserved.
states.active: Overlay display:flex, tooltip visible, current step rendered: header (.tutorial-step-header), body (.tutorial-step-body), optional extra content, nav with dots (.tutorial-dots > .tutorial-dot with .active on current) and button row (.tutorial-btn-row). Back button absent on first step. Next button absent on last step. Ring visible if target selector defined. Arrow key navigation active (Escape/ArrowRight/ArrowLeft/Enter).
states.final_step: Sub-state of active when stepIdx === STEPS.length - 1: Done button (.tutorial-btn-done) instead of Next button. renderExtra callback renders 'Do not show this again' checkbox inside extra container. Back button present (not first step). Ring positioned for final target (none in current implementation, so tooltip centered).

lifecycle.created_by: App constructor — Tutorial instance created once, three DOM elements (.tutorial-overlay, .tutorial-tooltip, .tutorial-ring) appended to document.body and hidden by default
lifecycle.destroyed_by: Tutorial.destroy() removes keydown listener and all three DOM elements from body
